simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַשְׁבֵּל (H788) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַשְׁבֵּל (ʼAshbêl) means Ashbel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 1.

definitions.full: H788. Ashbel אַשְׁבֵּל proper name, masculine (= אַשְׁבְּאֵל ? so Thes; more likely אֶשְׁבַּעַל ) 2nd son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 ( ᵐ5 Ἀσβηλ ) Num 26:38 ( ᵐ5 Ἀσυβηρ ) 1Chr 8:1 ( ᵐ5 B Σαβα , A & ᵐ5 L Ἀσβηλ ).
